text: In the years before the 2022 World Cup, migrant workers in Qatar faced widespread abuses, including unpaid wages, recruitment fees charged to workers, and deaths.

source.name: Human Rights Watch: Qatar: Rights Abuses Stain FIFA World Cup
source.quote: FIFA failed to impose strong conditions to protect workers and became a complacent enabler to the widespread abuse workers suffered, including illegal recruitment fees, wage theft, injuries, and deaths

additionalSources.name: Amnesty International: Qatar: Labour reform unfinished and compensation still owed as World Cup looms
additionalSources.quote: Migrant workers on both World Cup and non-World Cup related projects continue to face abuses on a significant scale in Qatar.
